items: Cat Couch Protector - Our couch scratch protector from cats, discourages your furry friend from scratching up the furniture while safeguarding fabric upholstery from pet claws and paws. These cat couch scratcher are not recommended for use on faux or real leather.

Extra Large - At 17" x 12", this sofa protector for cats can easily cover a full section of your sofa upholstery with a few sheets. Just cut the couch cat scratch protector transparent shield to size for the perfect fit.
Easy to Install - To set up these sleek cat scratch furniture protectors, simply peel off the self-adhesive pad and apply these. If needed, secure using the provided twist pins.
Strong Cat Couch Protectors - Thick enough to prevent scratching and flexible enough to cover all corners of your couch, our couch corner protectors for cats are the real deal.
Customer Satisfaction - If you find yourself scratching your head over a question about this cat tape for furniture, our team will be happy to assist you with a solution that sticks.
